$comment: #VAPP-220 (eApps A1, docs/spec/apps.md §7.1, decisions §18.2/§18.4): AN APP'S AUTOMATIONS. A package lists them in `automations: [{name, on, run, sponsor?}]`; the SERVER BROKER runs them on the PUBLISHED package only (V1), unattended, as the automation's SPONSOR. ONE TRIGGER RUNS ONE BINDING: no chains, no branches, no loops; anything with judgement goes to an agent (A2). THE FORMAT: `name` matches `limits.namePattern`, at most `limits.nameMax`, unique in the app; at most `limits.maxAutomations` automations (more = `{index: null, code: tooMany}` first; not a list = `{index: null, code: list}` alone). `on` holds EXACTLY ONE of `triggerKinds` (else `on`, which stops that automation's checks): `schedule` = `{cron, tz?}`: a 5-field cron (`minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week`, the agents' trigger cron: `*`, lists, ranges, steps, month and weekday names), read in `tz` (an IANA zone) or else the TEAM time zone; a cron that is not 5 fields of `cronFieldPattern`, a minute or hour field that does not parse (0-59, 0-23) or a blank `tz` = `schedule`; the minutes of a day it fires on (minute × hour, circular over the day) closer than `limits.minScheduleGapMinutes` apart = `scheduleTooOften`. `record` = `{kind, op}`: `kind` one the manifest declares (else `kind`), `op` one of `recordTriggerOps` (else `on`). `event` = a team event NAME (the agents' event triggers' stream: the server's `issue.created`, `pr.merged`, `session.ended`… or any `events_emit` name) matching `limits.eventPattern`, at most `limits.eventMax` (else `event`). `sponsor` (optional) = a member's email (a string holding `@`, else `sponsor`). `run` = an `exposes`-style run (exposes.json: exactly one of `records`, `action`, `upstream`, the same codes: `run`, `kind`, `action`, `destructive`, `ownerOnly`, `upstream`); an action reaching an app (`exponential.apps.*`) = `chain` (an automation never reaches an app, its own included, through the apps noun). TEMPLATES: every string of `run` may hold `${record.<path>}` (a record trigger only: the record's data + `id`; on delete, the data it had), `${event.<path>}` (an event trigger only: the event's payload + `name`) and `${firedAt}` (every trigger: the run's ISO instant); any other `${…}`, or a root the trigger does not carry, = `template`. Resolution = exposes.json's `resolveArgs` over the input `{record?, event?, firedAt}` after `toInputTemplates` rewrites each root to `${input.<root>…}` (`resolveCases`). VALIDATION = `validateAutomations(list, {kinds, upstreams})` → every `{index, code}` in order (`validateCases`, codes = `errors`). MATCHING (`matchCases`): a record write or an event names the automations it fires, in package order: a record trigger whose kind and op equal the write's, an event trigger whose name equals the event's; a schedule is never matched here (the watchdog tick finds the latest due minute since the last check, the agents' `latestCronMatch`, caught up once after downtime, never twice). LOOP GUARD: a write or event caused BY an automation run (`fromAutomation: true`: the run's records write, the events its action emits) fires NOTHING, so an automation never triggers another one or itself. SPONSOR (C23, `sponsorCases`): `resolveSponsor({declared, publishedBy, members})` where `members` = the team's current members `{id, email, role, level}` (`level` = the member's app access, Settings › MCP Access: `none` | `read` | `write`). The publisher = the member whose id = `publishedBy` (the member who published the running version). No `declared` sponsor → the sponsor is the publisher. A `declared` email naming someone other than the publisher is honoured only when the publisher is a team `owner` (an owner may delegate; a member never makes an automation act as someone else) → else `sponsorNotAllowed`. A sponsor who is not (or no longer) a member, or no publisher at all = `sponsorGone`; a sponsor whose level is not `write` = `sponsorReadOnly`. Any of those PAUSES the automation (it does not run; the app's owners get ONE notification per pause) until a publish resolves it. RATE: at most `limits.runsPerMinute` runs per app per rolling minute (the app's `automation:*` audit rows of the last 60 s); a run over the cap is not started and is audited `rateLimited` (`rateCases`). AUDIT (`auditCases`): every run (and every refusal) = one `mcp_calls` row (audit.json) with `user_id` = the sponsor (a paused run: the publisher, else the app's creator), `app_id` = the app, `client_id` = `clientPrefix` + name, `tool` = `automationTool(run)`: `records.<op>:<kind>`, the action name, or `<upstream>/<tool>`; its writes read "via <app>" (§9.3). The app's Settings › Automations lists each automation with its trigger and its newest audit row (last run, last failure), from those rows. AGENT HAND-OFF (#VAPP-236, A2, spec §7.3): `run` may be exposes.json's `agent` form `{agent, prompt, device?}` (the same checks and codes: `agent`, `prompt`, `run`); its `prompt` holds the trigger's templates (`${record.<path>}`, `${event.<path>}`, `${firedAt}`, checked like every run string) and the server renders exposes.json's `agentBrief` over the input `{record?, event?, firedAt}` (after `toInputTemplates`), `source` = `automation <name>`, `ref` = `{kind, id}` of a record trigger's record; it runs as the SPONSOR through `sessions.send {agentId}` (the sponsor's conversation with that agent), the session reading `via <app>`, under exposes.json's hand-off cap as well as `limits.runsPerMinute`; its audit `tool` = `agent:<slug>` (`auditCases`). AGENT LOOP GUARD (`matchCases` with `byAgent`): a record write or an event caused from inside an AGENT's session tree (the acting agent of the causing session's root: its conversation agent, else the agent that started it) carries that agent's slug as `byAgent`; it never fires an automation whose run hands off to THAT agent, so an agent an automation woke never re-triggers it (nor any other hand-off to itself); every other automation still fires.

validateCases.name: the spec's three automations are valid
a schedule in its own zone, every quarter hour
names: pattern, duplicate, not an object
on: none, two, an unknown record op
schedules: four fields, a bad hour, a blank zone, every minute, every five minutes, two close minutes across midnight
an undeclared trigger kind, a bad event name, a sponsor that is no email
templates: a root the trigger lacks, an unknown root, input
runs: the exposes codes, and no chaining through the apps noun
an agent hand-off on a record create, and its refusals

matchCases.name: a record create fires the create automations of its kind, in order
an event fires the automations on its name
LOOP GUARD: an automation's own write fires nothing (not even itself)
LOOP GUARD: an event an automation's action emitted fires nothing
a malformed entry is skipped, never fired
AGENT LOOP GUARD: an agent's own write never fires a hand-off to it
AGENT LOOP GUARD: an event from an agent's tree, and a person's write fires all
no acting agent: every hand-off fires

sponsorCases.name: an owner delegates to another member (emails compare case-blind)
a member never makes an automation act as someone else
the named sponsor is no member
the sponsor's app access is read
the delegated sponsor's app access is none

resolveCases.name: a record's fields keep their type when whole, become text inside text
an event's payload, the instant, a missing field dropped
